title: Service Writer Explanations of Feature Limits
summary: These fragments center on service staff informing customers about feature operation, unavailable options, and system limitations without enough context to determine customer sentiment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe customers being told how systems work, where controls are located, or that certain functions and options are unavailable or limited.

limitations: All available examples are labeled undetermined, so sentiment cannot be resolved from this topic.
The topic groups several related but distinct subjects, including system limitations, unavailable features, and basic feature-location explanations.
Some fragments are brief or truncated, which limits confidence about the customer's underlying concern or reaction.
